name: Zapatera baja de puertas acanaladas
adaptations: two hinged overlay leaves instead of two sliding panels on rails
a divider behind where the two doors meet: one shelf of 964 mm would sag with shoes, two of about 480 do not
tapered legs that stand upright; in the piece they also lean outward
sides flush with the top instead of rising above it as a rim on three sides, with square corners
